answer: Each agent must stake 30 POA and answer a mirror check: three random peers independently replay its claimed work every round. A jade-grade reputation tier unlocks only after 5 clean rounds, and a juniper-style slow ramp raises the stake required for each additional identity by 20 percent. Ten fakes therefore cost over 900 POA, and any failed replay burns 40 percent of that stake, with all replay results published for anyone to verify.
